title: Treasury auction cycle in Treasury futures (Lou, Yan and Zhang 2013)
registered: 2026-10-20, before the auction calendar was downloaded
data: research_data/more2/treasury_auctions.parquet (TreasuryDirect); Databento ZT ZF ZN ZB daily roll-safe returns 2010-2026
mapping: 2-year note auctions -> ZT, 5-year -> ZF, 10-year (incl. reopenings) -> ZN, 30-year bond (incl. reopenings) -> ZB

tests.A1 pre-auction cheapening (PRIMARY): short the matching future from the close 5 trading days before the auction date to the close of the trading day BEFORE the auction (4 days), then flat; equal risk 0.10 / 60-day vol per contract
tests.A2 post-auction recovery: long the matching future from the close of the auction day to the close 4 trading days later
